name: proof-usage
about: QA proofs (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-qa-proofs.md), the usage kind and the 30-minute recheck. The build states a proof: a usage check, 'a claim by the hand runner' (as #94's 'a lease held by runner mbp or mini'). The item reaches qa; the thread says the loop checks it itself, with no mention of the approver. The runner's first proof pass finds no such claim since the merge (the item's own triage claim, before it, does not count) and posts nothing. The hand runner claims another item; 29 minutes later nothing is checked again; at 30 minutes the check sees the claim and the loop verifies the item (actor 'loop (proof)').

a.body:
\*\*Proof\*\* \(what the loop checks once this is merged and in qa\):

- usage: `claimed` by runner:hand

messages.text: #1 Hand runner claims: Merged — the loop checks it itself: usage: `claimed` by runner:hand\. <https://github.com/sandbox/demo/pull/101\|sandbox/demo#101> merged as `[0-9a-f]{7}`; watching main's CI\.\nIt is verified when every automatic check passes, and reopened if one fails twice in a row; Verified and Reopen still work by hand\.
